_README: The Music Agent will ONLY use a track that has an entry in this file with a known
license. A track without an entry is treated as unknown-rights and is refused —
the video renders narration-only rather than risking a copyright claim.
Layout: place audio files in mood subdirectories under this directory:
Then add one entry per FILENAME (not path) below.
Accepted license values: CC0, public-domain, licensed, royalty-free, owned.

example-track.mp3.creator: Composer Name
example-track.mp3.notes: replace this entry with your real tracks
